what: Vision and language models: captions, tags, and text from a prompt inside a graph.
dossier:
1. If the task is specific, structured, or requires bounding boxes/OCR:
   Use Florence-2.
   Florence-2 uses a prompt-based approach to handle specific vision tasks like captioning, object detection, and segmentation [MODEL.md].
   It supports specific prompt tokens such as <CAPTION>, <DETAILED_CAPTION>, <OD> (Object Detection), <OCR>, <DENSE_REGION_CAPTION>, and <REGION_PROPOSAL> [MODEL.md].
   If VRAM is constrained or speed is critical: Use florence2/Florence-2-base (0.23B params, fp16, 0.43 GB) [MODEL.md].
   If higher quality or detailed prompt generation is needed: Use florence2/large-promptgen (0.82B params, f32, 3.07 GB) [MODEL.md].
   If specific fine-tuned captioning is needed: Us
